The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean on a high-quality subset (pool4) may beat the full-trimmed mean.

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9832. Series context: trend strength 0.9886 and seasonal strength 0.4332; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.17); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.082.
